description: Binary checks after adding or modifying the crypto snapshot skill or scraper. Each item must be true for the run to pass.

binary_assertions.assertion: python -m py_compile atlas_agents/crypto/crypto_scraper.py exits with code 0 from the ATLAS repo root.
binary_assertions.verify: Shell: run from workspace root containing atlas_agents/.

binary_assertions.assertion: After a successful run of python atlas_agents/crypto/crypto_scraper.py, data_cache/crypto_top50_latest.json exists and parses as JSON with top-level keys including generated_at, merge_policy, coin_count, and coins.
binary_assertions.verify: Shell: optionally run scraper with network available; jq or Python json.load validates shape.
